label: Stablecoin Payment Rails and Infrastructure
summary: This cluster focuses on bridging digital and traditional finance through stablecoin-based payment systems that facilitate seamless cross-border transactions and instant fiat settlement.

representativeProjects.name: FlowFi Pay
representativeProjects.oneLiner: Instant USDC-to-fiat payment gateway for businesses on Solana.

representativeProjects.name: StablPay
representativeProjects.oneLiner: Cross-border payment infrastructure converting local currencies to stablecoins for seamless global settlement.

representativeProjects.name: Stableyard
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A programmable infrastructure layer for stablecoin-based payments.

representativeProjects.name: Flipeet Pay
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A stablecoin payment rail providing seamless fiat on-ramp and off-ramp services.

representativeProjects.name: CrossPay
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A crypto payment platform enabling seamless stablecoin-to-fiat transactions for merchants and consumers.
